findings.summary: EstateService._handle_message writes the inbox_event INSERT in one transaction and calls upsert_signal/resolve_signal in a second. A crash between them permanently loses the signal. Merge both writes into a single db.tx() as done in the triage fix.
httpx.get (synchronous) is called inside JWTMiddleware.dispatch (async). A JWKS cache miss blocks the event loop for up to 5 s. Replace with asyncio.to_thread or httpx.AsyncClient.

_get_cap reads ai_settings in a separate transaction before the FOR UPDATE lock on llm_usage. An admin disabling AI or lowering the cap between those two transactions is not caught. Read ai_settings inside the locking transaction or document the accepted race.

_build_user_prompt includes prior history from content_redacted columns, so [PHONE]/[EMAIL] tokens appear verbatim in subsequent prompts. Intentional but undocumented; should be noted as a deliberate design choice.
